qa_notes: Plan camera markers and legend all point north, including B at the north end. The legend says C SOUTH but still shows an upward/N arrow. The north-approach image is another north-looking view, while the reverse view flips storefront/tree sides. Labels and bearings cannot currently define a reliable reverse setup. Correction: Choose the actual north-looking and south-looking plates, label them by camera position plus viewing direction, and redraw B/C bearings. Do not treat all arrows as valid.

The plan places 7-Catleven south of the east alley, but the east-looking alley view shows its frontage on the left/north side. The alley-mouth reverse also places the store across/right rather than presenting the expected corner relationship from the mapped alley. Correction: Lock the store and alley corner with LOC06 before any continuous street-to-alley move. Retain the main-street design and establish one coherent east-alley corner for scene plates; do not use panel 9 as proven geographic coverage.
Useful empty District7 street design and textures. Alley/store corner and camera annotations remain drafts. No regeneration retry requested.
